To perform certain actions (such as locking your phone) when performing a gesture, CyberHome requires accessibility access.

CyberHome doesn't watch any user action, though the privilege to do so is required for all accessibility services. CyberHome discards any event sent by the system.

In order to lock your phone, or to open the Recents screen, CyberHome uses the performGlobalAction Accessibility service.

To put the device to sleep, set CyberHome as a device admin app. Tap \"Open settings\", then tap \"Activate this device admin app.\"
To %1$s, turn on the CyberHome accessibility service. Tap \"Open settings\", select \"CyberHome\" and turn on \"Use CyberHome.\"

CyberHome uses Accessibility\'s `performGlobalAction` method to perform this action. This is a sensitive permission that allows monitoring other apps. However, CyberHome is not configured for that functionality and receives no events.
